meta.question: which masked-teacher statistic (accuracy, true-class probability, confident errors, entropy, KL to the full teacher; worst-group or minority mean; self vs common student) rank-predicts the student's worst-group accuracy across selectors and K?
meta.method: group-sliced faithfulness and calibration of the masked teacher under each selector's attention map (CLS attention, attention rollout), validated against trained students by rank correlation
meta.paper: Abnar & Zuidema ACL 2020 (rollout); Hooker et al. NeurIPS 2019 (ROAR-style keep-only evaluation); Sagawa et al. ICLR 2020 (Waterbirds groups); Guo et al. ICML 2017 (calibration)
